0022600091.text: The Houston Rockets host the Dallas Mavericks in a game where both teams open their 2026-27 seasons, and it is the first game of the season for Houston. The teams split their four meetings in 2025-26 at 2-2, and the Rockets most recently beat the Mavericks 111-107 in Houston on January 31, 2026. Dallas is missing Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Jett Howard (illness), Santi Aldama (knee), and Tarik Biberovic (heel), all listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Rockets a 70% chance to win.
